title: Fit three clusters to standardized Iris data
description: You inspect the clustering call and its recorded return values.

steps.description: You set k to three. The next call uses that value as its cluster count.

steps.question: Which feature representation does the clustering call receive?
steps.answer: It receives X_std, the standardized features. The call also requests 20 initializations and supplies SEED.

steps.description: You collect centroids C, labels, inertia, and hist from the call. max_iter=300 and tol=1e-7 are the supplied iteration and tolerance settings.
You print the cluster count, inertia, and history length. The recording reports k=3, inertia=139.8205, and five history entries.
